name: Turkey Ground
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Choose lean ground turkey to minimize fat content if fat sensitivity is present.
preparationTips: Cook thoroughly to 165°F internal temperature for food safety
Drain excess fat after cooking to aid digestion
Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like oregano, basil, or thyme
Avoid pre-seasoned varieties that may contain garlic or onion powder
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially niacin and B6
Good source of selenium and phosphorus
Lower in saturated fat than ground beef
